Name: Disable Key Vault Public Network Access
Description: The Azure Key Vault allows access through its public network endpoint. Disable public network access and use private connectivity where appropriate.
ImpactWarning: Applications and users accessing the vault through its public endpoint may lose connectivity. Verify private endpoint connectivity, DNS and network configuration before applying.

Name: Disable SQL Server Public Network Access
Description: The Azure SQL Server allows access through its public network endpoint. Disable public network access and use private connectivity where appropriate.
ImpactWarning: Applications and clients using the public endpoint may lose connectivity. Verify private endpoints, DNS and application connectivity before applying.

Name: Disable Storage Account Public Blob Access
Description: The Storage Account permits anonymous public access to blobs and containers. Disable public blob access unless explicitly required by the workload.
ImpactWarning: Applications and users relying on anonymous blob access may lose access. Review containers, applications and integrations before applying.

Name: Disable Web App Public Network Access
Description: The Azure Web App allows access through its public network endpoint. Disable public network access and use private connectivity where appropriate.
ImpactWarning: Publicly accessible application endpoints may become unavailable. Verify private endpoint configuration, DNS, access restrictions and application dependencies before applying.
